title: Good Leader
subtitle: 「好領導者」，究竟是哪一種「領導得好」？
description: 「好領導者」，究竟是哪一種「領導得好」？

words.meaning: 有效的領導者；能帶來成果的領袖
words.note: 最直接、最實用的近義說法之一，強調領導者能帶領團隊達成目標、解決問題並取得實際成果。
words.example: An effective leader gives clear direction and helps the team meet its goals.
words.exampleZh: 一位有效的領導者會提供清晰方向，並幫助團隊達成目標。

exercises.original: The team improved quickly because she was a good leader who gave clear direction and followed up on problems.
exercises.zh: 團隊迅速進步，因為她是一位能提供清晰方向並跟進問題的好領導者。
exercises.upgrade: effective leader · 有效的領導者；能帶來成果的領袖

options.explanation: popular person = 被喜歡不代表能改善團隊表現。
strict leader = 句子沒有強調嚴格，而是 direction 和 follow-up。
effective leader = clear direction 加上 team improved，直接顯示她的領導產生實際成果，因此 effective leader 最精確。
manager = 可能是經理，但本句重點是領導成效。
charismatic person = 沒有個人魅力線索。
efficient leader = 效率不是句子主要證據。

exercises.original: A good leader helps people understand their goals and keeps the project moving.
exercises.zh: 好領導者會幫助大家理解目標，並令項目持續推進。
exercises.upgrade: effective leader · 有效的領導者；能帶來成果的領袖

options.explanation: boss = 有權力未必能做到這些。
popular leader = 受歡迎不等於達成目標。
strict leader = 沒有嚴格管理線索。
effective leader = 能令團隊明白目標並保持項目進度，屬有效領導的核心，因此 effective leader 很自然。
manager = 較偏行政安排。
charismatic leader = 沒有魅力相關線索。

exercises.original: The organization needs a good leader who can turn the new strategy into results.
exercises.zh: 組織需要一位能把新策略轉化為成果的好領導者。
exercises.upgrade: effective leader · 有效的領導者；能帶來成果的領袖

options.explanation: popular person = 人氣不能保證 strategy 變成 results。
boss = 職位本身不夠。
strict leader = 嚴格不等於產生成果。
manager = 可執行策略，但本句重點是 leadership effectiveness。
effective leader = turn ... strategy into results 是 effectiveness 的直接線索。
inspiring speaker = 只是演說能力。

words.meaning: 有能力的帶領者；可靠的引導者
words.note: 較描述性，強調某人有能力為其他人提供方向、建議和支持；比 leader 稍柔和。
words.example: She proved to be a capable guide during the team's first major project.
words.exampleZh: 在團隊第一個大型項目中，她證明自己是一位有能力的帶領者。

exercises.original: During the expedition, she was a good leader who kept everyone calm and showed them what to do.
exercises.zh: 探險期間，她是一位有能力的帶領者，令大家保持冷靜並知道該做甚麼。
exercises.upgrade: capable guide · 有能力的帶領者；可靠的引導者

options.explanation: boss = 探險語境不一定有正式上下級。
manager = 過於組織職位化。
popular person = 不合。
capable guide = 她的角色是提供方向並協助大家安全行動，因此 capable guide 很貼切。
strict guide = 沒有嚴格線索。
charismatic guide = 沒有魅力線索。

exercises.original: The mentor became a good leader for the younger staff, helping them handle difficult situations.
exercises.zh: 這位導師成為年輕員工可靠的帶領者，幫助他們處理困難情況。
exercises.upgrade: capable guide · 有能力的帶領者；可靠的引導者

options.explanation: boss = mentor 不一定有正式權力。
manager = 不是行政管理重點。
popular colleague = 不合。
strict supervisor = 改變角色和語氣。
capable guide = mentor 的核心是引導、支持，而非正式管理，因此 capable guide 最自然。
efficient worker = 不是帶領他人。

exercises.original: In the unfamiliar environment, the group needed a good leader who knew the area well.
exercises.zh: 在陌生環境中，小組需要一位熟悉當地的有能力帶領者。
exercises.upgrade: capable guide · 有能力的帶領者；可靠的引導者

options.explanation: manager = 不是行政場景。
boss = 不合。
popular local = 熟悉當地不等於能帶領。
strict leader = 不合。
speaker = 不合。
capable guide = knew the area well 加上帶領 group 的需要，最自然是 capable guide。

words.meaning: 稱職的領導者；有能力的領袖
words.note: 強調具備完成領導工作所需的知識、判斷和技能，語氣較中性、正式。
words.example: A competent leader can organize people and respond calmly to problems.
words.exampleZh: 一位稱職的領導者能組織人員，並冷靜應對問題。

exercises.original: The board wanted a good leader who understood both finance and staff management.
exercises.zh: 董事會希望有一位懂財務和人員管理的稱職領導者。
exercises.upgrade: competent leader · 稱職的領導者；有能力的領袖

options.explanation: popular leader = 沒有 popularity 線索。
strict leader = 沒有嚴格線索。
charismatic person = 技能知識比魅力重要。
boss = 只是職位稱呼。
competent leader = finance 和 staff management 都是職務能力，重點是勝任程度，因此 competent leader 最精確。
friendly manager = 友善不是主要標準。

exercises.original: She proved to be a good leader by handling the crisis calmly and making sound decisions.
exercises.zh: 她透過冷靜處理危機和作出穩健決定，證明自己是一位稱職的領導者。
exercises.upgrade: competent leader · 稱職的領導者；有能力的領袖

options.explanation: popular person = 沒有受歡迎線索。
strict leader = 不合。
manager = 可以是職位，但不突出勝任能力。
charismatic leader = 沒有魅力線索。
kind person = 仁慈不是本句重點。
competent leader = 冷靜處理 crisis 並作出 sound decisions 直接證明她具備領導所需能力，因此 competent leader 最合適。

exercises.original: A good leader should be able to organize resources and make reliable decisions.
exercises.zh: 好領導者應能組織資源並作出可靠決定。
exercises.upgrade: competent leader · 稱職的領導者；有能力的領袖

options.explanation: competent leader = 句子列出工作能力和判斷力，因此 competent leader 最自然。
popular leader = 不合。
strict leader = 不合。
charismatic person = 不合。
boss = 未必 competent。
efficient process = 不是人。

words.note: 表示某人具備足夠能力、判斷力和實務技巧去領導他人，和 good leader 很接近。
words.example: The department needs a capable leader who can manage rapid change.
words.exampleZh: 部門需要一位能應對快速變化的有能力領導者。

exercises.original: The department needs a good leader who can manage a period of major change.
exercises.zh: 部門需要一位有能力帶領重大轉變的領導者。
exercises.upgrade: capable leader · 有能力的領導者

options.explanation: popular leader = 人氣與變革管理能力不同。
boss = 有職權未必能應對 change。
strict leader = 沒有嚴格要求線索。
charismatic person = 不合。
friendly colleague = 不是領導角色。
capable leader = 能 manage major change 顯示整體能力，因此 capable leader 最精確。

exercises.original: They chose her because they believed she was a good leader who could handle the responsibility.
exercises.zh: 他們選擇她，因為相信她有能力承擔領導責任。
exercises.upgrade: capable leader · 有能力的領導者

options.explanation: capable leader = could handle the responsibility 直接說明 capability，因此 capable leader 很自然。
manager = 職稱不能直接證明能力。
popular person = 受歡迎不代表能承擔責任。
strict leader = 不合。
charismatic leader = 不合。
kind person = 不合。

exercises.original: A good leader can remain calm while coordinating several teams at once.
exercises.zh: 有能力的領導者能在同時協調數個團隊時保持冷靜。
exercises.upgrade: capable leader · 有能力的領導者

options.explanation: popular leader = 不合。
capable leader = 同時協調多個 teams 並保持冷靜，需要整體領導能力，因此 capable leader 最貼切。
boss = 太泛。
strict leader = 沒有嚴格線索。
charismatic person = 不合。
efficient worker = 不是領導多隊的重點。

words.meaning: 有技巧的領導者；領導能力強的人
words.note: 強調領導技巧，例如溝通、協調、決策和處理衝突的能力。
words.example: He is a skilled leader who knows how to resolve disagreements within the team.
words.exampleZh: 他是一位很有領導技巧的人，懂得處理團隊內的分歧。

exercises.original: He is a good leader who is especially good at resolving conflict between team members.
exercises.zh: 他是一位很有領導技巧的人，尤其擅長解決團隊成員之間的衝突。
exercises.upgrade: skilled leader · 有技巧的領導者；領導能力強的人

options.explanation: skilled leader = especially good at resolving conflict 明確強調領導技巧，因此 skilled leader 最精確。
popular leader = 受歡迎不等於會處理 conflict。
strict leader = 嚴格可能反而加劇衝突。
boss = 不突出技巧。
charismatic person = 個人魅力不等於 conflict-resolution skill。
neutral observer = 不是領導者。

exercises.original: The project succeeded because a good leader coordinated people from several departments.
exercises.zh: 項目成功，是因為一位有技巧的領導者協調了數個部門的人員。
exercises.upgrade: skilled leader · 有技巧的領導者；領導能力強的人

options.explanation: popular person = 不合。
skilled leader = 跨部門 coordination 是具體領導技能，因此 skilled leader 很自然。
strict supervisor = 沒有嚴格線索。
boss = 過於泛化。
charismatic speaker = 不是協調工作。
friendly colleague = 不是領導。

exercises.original: A good leader knows how to communicate difficult decisions without damaging trust.
exercises.zh: 有技巧的領導者懂得如何傳達困難決定，同時不破壞信任。
exercises.upgrade: skilled leader · 有技巧的領導者；領導能力強的人

options.explanation: popular leader = 這不只是受歡迎。
strict leader = 不合。
skilled leader = 句子聚焦 communication skill，因此 skilled leader 最貼切。
manager = 職位本身不代表 communication skill。
charismatic person = 不一定能處理 difficult decisions。
kind person = 不是純粹仁慈。

words.meaning: 強而有力的領導者；有領導力的人
words.note: 常見說法，通常表示領導者果斷、有方向感、能承擔責任；但 strong 不等於嚴厲或專制。
words.example: The organization needs a strong leader during the transition.
words.exampleZh: 組織在轉型期間需要一位有力的領導者。

exercises.original: The organization needed a good leader to provide direction during the transition.
exercises.zh: 組織在轉型期間需要一位有力的領導者提供方向。
exercises.upgrade: strong leader · 強而有力的領導者；有領導力的人

options.explanation: popular person = 不合。
strong leader = transition 期間需要清晰方向和承擔責任，常自然說 strong leader。
kind leader = 不一定能提供方向。
strict leader = strong 不等於 strict。
manager = 可能管理流程，但句子強調 leadership direction。
friendly boss = 不合。

exercises.original: People looked to her as a good leader when the organization faced uncertainty.
exercises.zh: 組織面對不確定性時，人們把她視為有力的領導者。
exercises.upgrade: strong leader · 強而有力的領導者；有領導力的人

options.explanation: popular leader = 人氣不是核心。
strict leader = 沒有嚴格線索。
strong leader = 在 uncertainty 中大家依賴她提供方向，strong leader 很自然。
charismatic person = 不合。
boss = 過於職位化。
efficient manager = 效率不是本句重點。

exercises.original: The crisis showed why the team needed a good leader who could make firm decisions.
exercises.zh: 危機顯示團隊為何需要一位能作出堅定決定的有力領導者。
exercises.upgrade: strong leader · 強而有力的領導者；有領導力的人

options.explanation: kind leader = firm decisions 不是仁慈問題。
popular leader = 不合。
strict leader = firm 不等於 strict。
strong leader = firm decisions + crisis 是 strong leader 的典型語境。
manager = 不一定有領導力。
charismatic leader = 不合。

words.note: 較正式、稍傳統，表示具備足夠才幹和判斷力去有效帶領他人。
words.example: She was widely regarded as an able leader during the crisis.
words.exampleZh: 在危機期間，她被廣泛視為一位有能力的領導者。

exercises.original: She was considered a good leader because she managed the organization successfully through a difficult year.
exercises.zh: 她被視為一位有能力的領導者，成功帶領組織渡過艱難一年。
exercises.upgrade: able leader · 有能力的領導者

options.explanation: popular leader = 不合。
strict leader = 不合。
able leader = 成功管理 organization 渡過 difficult year，較正式可稱 able leader。
boss = 過於泛。
kind person = 不合。
charismatic speaker = 不合。

exercises.original: The group was fortunate to have a good leader with sound judgment and practical experience.
exercises.zh: 小組很幸運有一位具穩健判斷和實際經驗的有能力領導者。
exercises.upgrade: able leader · 有能力的領導者

options.explanation: popular leader = 不合。
strict leader = 沒有嚴格線索。
manager = 未必能概括 judgment and experience。
able leader = sound judgment and practical experience 是 ability 的直接證據，因此 able leader 很貼切。
charismatic person = 不合。
friendly colleague = 不合。

exercises.original: They needed a good leader who could take control of a complex situation.
exercises.zh: 他們需要一位有能力掌控複雜局面的領導者。
exercises.upgrade: able leader · 有能力的領導者

options.explanation: popular person = 不合。
boss = 有職權不代表能處理 complex situation。
strict leader = 不合。
charismatic leader = 不合。
able leader = 能 take control of complex situation，較正式可說 able leader。
kind person = 不合。

words.meaning: 有效的引導者；善於帶領的人
words.note: 當重點不是正式權力，而是提供方向、協助他人成長或完成任務時，可用這個描述性說法。
words.example: The mentor was an effective guide for new members of the profession.
words.exampleZh: 這位導師是行業新人的有效引導者。

exercises.original: The mentor was a good leader for new employees who were unfamiliar with the industry.
exercises.zh: 這位導師對不熟悉行業的新員工而言，是一位有效的引導者。
exercises.upgrade: effective guide · 有效的引導者；善於帶領的人

options.explanation: boss = mentor 不一定管理他們。
manager = 過於職位化。
popular colleague = 不合。
effective guide = mentor 的主要功能是提供方向和協助，因此 effective guide 比正式 leader 更貼切。
strict supervisor = 不合。
charismatic person = 不合。

exercises.original: She became a good leader for the students as they planned their first research project.
exercises.zh: 學生籌備首個研究項目時，她成為有效的引導者。
exercises.upgrade: effective guide · 有效的引導者；善於帶領的人

options.explanation: boss = 不合教育引導。
manager = 學生不是員工。
popular teacher = 不等於有效引導。
strict teacher = 不合。
effective guide = 她是協助學生完成第一次 project 的引導者，因此 effective guide 很自然。
charismatic speaker = 不合。

exercises.original: The handbook acts as a good leader for beginners learning the process.
exercises.zh: 這本手冊對學習該流程的初學者而言，是一個有效的引導工具。
exercises.upgrade: effective guide · 有效的引導者；善於帶領的人

options.explanation: boss = handbook 不是人。
manager = 不合。
leader = 物件可以 metaphorically guide，但 guide 更自然。
speaker = 不合。
supervisor = 不合。
effective guide = 因為主語是 handbook，不是人，所以 effective guide 是比 leader 更自然的改寫。

words.meaning: 有智慧的領導者；明智的領袖
words.note: 當 good leader 特別強調判斷力、遠見和作出明智決定時可用；不是所有 good leaders 都一定以 wisdom 為主要特徵。
words.example: A wise leader listens carefully before making a difficult decision.
words.exampleZh: 一位有智慧的領導者會在作出困難決定前仔細聆聽。

exercises.original: A good leader listens to several viewpoints before making a difficult decision.
exercises.zh: 有智慧的領導者會在作出困難決定前聆聽多種觀點。
exercises.upgrade: wise leader · 有智慧的領導者；明智的領袖

options.explanation: popular leader = 不合。
strict leader = 不合。
efficient leader = 效率不是主要線索。
charismatic leader = 不合。
wise leader = 先聆聽多方觀點再作 difficult decision，重點是 judgment，因此 wise leader 最精確。
boss = 職位太泛。

exercises.original: The community needed a good leader who could think beyond the immediate crisis.
exercises.zh: 社區需要一位能看得超越眼前危機的有智慧領導者。
exercises.upgrade: wise leader · 有智慧的領導者；明智的領袖

options.explanation: popular person = 不合。
strict leader = 不合。
manager = 不一定具有遠見。
charismatic person = 不等於有智慧。
friendly leader = 不合。
wise leader = think beyond the immediate crisis 強調遠見和智慧，因此 wise leader 很自然。

exercises.original: A good leader recognizes when advice from others is better than their own first idea.
exercises.zh: 有智慧的領導者懂得承認別人的建議有時比自己的第一個想法更好。
exercises.upgrade: wise leader · 有智慧的領導者；明智的領袖

options.explanation: wise leader = 懂得判斷、接受更好的建議，屬 wisdom，因此 wise leader 最貼切。
popular leader = 不合。
strict leader = 方向相反。
charismatic person = 不合。
boss = 太泛。
efficient manager = 不是效率問題。

words.note: 當 good leader 的核心在於激勵、鼓舞和提升團隊士氣時適用；語義比一般 good leader 更具體。
words.example: She is an inspiring leader who motivates people to do their best work.
words.exampleZh: 她是一位鼓舞人心的領導者，能激勵人們發揮最佳表現。

exercises.original: She is a good leader who motivates people to believe they can achieve more.
exercises.zh: 她是一位鼓舞人心的領導者，能激勵人們相信自己可以做得更多。
exercises.upgrade: inspiring leader · 鼓舞人心的領導者

options.explanation: popular leader = 受歡迎不等於能激勵別人。
strict leader = 不合。
manager = 未必能激發動力。
boss = 不合。
efficient leader = 效率不是 motivation。
inspiring leader = motivates people 是 inspiring leader 的直接線索。

exercises.original: The coach was a good leader who gave the team confidence after several defeats.
exercises.zh: 球隊連敗後，教練仍是一位鼓舞人心的領導者，給隊員信心。
exercises.upgrade: inspiring leader · 鼓舞人心的領導者

options.explanation: inspiring leader = 在 defeats 後提升 confidence，重點是鼓舞作用，因此 inspiring leader 最自然。
strict leader = 失敗後給 confidence 不是嚴格管理。
popular person = 不合。
manager = 不是行政管理語境。
boss = 不合。
efficient organizer = 不合。

exercises.original: People described him as a good leader because his example encouraged others to serve the community.
exercises.zh: 人們稱他為鼓舞人心的領導者，因為他的榜樣鼓勵其他人服務社區。
exercises.upgrade: inspiring leader · 鼓舞人心的領導者

options.explanation: popular leader = 不合。
inspiring leader = his example encouraged others 明確表示 inspiration，因此 inspiring leader 最精確。
strict leader = 不合。
boss = 不合。
manager = 不合。
efficient leader = 不合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 上司不一定是好領導 boss 只表示有管理權力的人；有職位不代表具備良好領導能力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A boss has authority, but a good leader earns trust and guides people effectively.

falseSynonyms.zh: 經理不一定等於領導者 manager 通常負責安排、流程和資源；leader 更強調方向、影響和帶領他人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A manager may organize work, while a leader also provides direction and motivation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 受歡迎的人不等於好領導 受歡迎不代表能作出好決定、承擔責任或帶領團隊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A popular person may be liked, but that does not automatically make them an effective leader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 嚴格不等於領導得好 嚴格只是管理風格之一；良好領導還包括判斷、溝通、信任和適應能力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A strict leader may enforce rules, but strictness alone does not make leadership good.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有魅力不等於好領導 charismatic 表示個人魅力強；魅力可以幫助領導，但不能取代能力和判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Charisma can attract followers, but it does not guarantee effective leadership.

falseSynonyms.zh: 人與能力／制度不同 leader 指人；leadership 指領導能力、領導行為或領導層。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is a strong leader. Her leadership helped the team recover.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞與名詞不同 lead 是動詞，表示帶領；leader 是名詞，表示帶領別人的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She leads the team. She is the team leader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有效與高效率不同 effective 表示能達成目標；efficient 表示用較少時間或資源完成工作。好領導需要有效，但不只是高效率。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An effective leader achieves the right outcomes; an efficient process uses resources well.
